The self-test accepts a valid manifest and rejects an omitted HTML entry while retaining the five existing rejecting mutations.
[README](../benchmark/native/job/README.md) adds the known-behaviour dispatch and compile-only exclusion clauses, describes HTML transfer, and names the PNG companion gap.
CLI parameters, safe loading/no-save behaviour, and substantive readiness gaps remain explicitly unverified.

Verification: `python3 -I -B benchmark/native/job/native_job.py --self-test` exited 0.
Observed output accepted the baseline and rejected all six mutations; native_executed=false and readiness_claim=false.

No native execution, readiness or quality claim is made.

## What next
Obtain independent cross-family review before an Owner installation decision for #169. The Policymaker should verify the command and upload paths on main; do not infer readiness from synthetic checks.
